saw_lines: Grocery buyers in Nairobi trust an app after one good delivery, then reorder staples on repeat without comparing.
So the first order is won or lost in the opening line, when a new buyer decides if delivery is worth trying.
Your site shows 500,000 orders and over 80,000 customers, yet 0 of 30 ads use either. Put 500,000 orders on the creative and in line one of two ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 500,000 orders and over 80,000 customers, yet none of your 30 live ads use either number. New buyers need that proof before they order. Put 500,000 orders on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 27 copy ads mention it. A new buyer sees no reason to order today. Open three new ads with that discount in line one and print it on the creative.

7 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product. Each extra search costs a sale. Point each of those 7 ads to the product it shows, such as the stewing steak or the spinach bunch.
Your 27 copy ads open with 17 different stories, and the farm one leads just 4 ads. Pick the two strongest, the farm trace and the empty fridge, and build the next batch of ads from them.

ads_1: Empty fridge and farm trace hooks, with the first order discount in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok and Youtube
